title: processDescendants
responsibility: Follows the processes a command started, by their parent links, and stops those that outlive it; each is identified by its id and start time, so nothing else is ever signalled.

outputs.name: processDescendants
outputs.type: { /** Looks once; overlapping looks are skipped. */ look(): Promise<void>; /** Followed processes that still exist, the command itself excluded. */ survivors(): Promise<TrackedProcess[]>; }
